4. The respondents as defendants contested the aforesaid application by filing written objection contending, inter alia, that the suit property along with other properties were sold in Rent Execution Case No.269 of 1.932. Taherun Nessa and Khetra Mohan and others partitioned their land among themselves and 7.97 acres land of Plot No.522 fell in saham of Khetra Mohan and the land of Plot No.520 along with the land of other plots fell in the saham of Taherun Nessa Bebi and accordingly, S.A. Khatian No.49 was correctly prepared in their names. 2.92 acres land of C.S. Plot No.522 was acquired by the Government for the construction of Dhaka Aricha Road through L.A. Case No.39/51-52 and that while rest 5.05 acres land of C.S. Plot No.522 remained in possession of Khetra Mohan Paul and others, they transferred the said land to Chan Miah through Registered Sub-kabala Deed dated 20.04.1962 and delivered possession to them. Thereafter, Chan Miah transferred 3.29 acres land to Korpula Bibi by Registered Deed No.329 dated 10.01.1963. While Taherun Nessa and Chan Miah had been in possession of their land of C.S. Plot No.520, they transferred 7.73 acres land to Abdur Rob and others vide Registered Deed No.431 dated 16.01.1993. Korpula Bibi transferred 2.31 acres land to Alhaj Sekender Khan through Registered Sub-kabala Deed Nos.3498, 3499, 3500 and 3502. Korpula Bibi on 25.05.1963 further transferred 0.98 acre land to Mrs. Momtaz Akter Kashem through Deed No.3501. Chan Miah transferred her rest 1.76 acres land to Alhaj Sekander Khan on 24.04.1963 through two Registered Deed Nos.4777 and 4778 and delivered possession of the same to the purchaser. Thereafter, Momataz Akter Kashem transferred 0.98 acre land through a sab-kabala Deed being No.4256 to defendant No.1, A.K.M. Jahangir Khan. The land of CS and SA Plot No.522 was recorded in the name of defendant No.1 and his father, Sekander Khan measuring 0.98 and 4.07 acres respectively and that in R.S.Khatian No.221, the said record of rights was correctly prepared in his name. Thereafter, Alhaj Sakender Khan died leaving behind his wife-Mrs. Tahera Khatun, one son, AKM Jahangir Khan. (the defendant) and four daughters who got their names mutated and they had been in possession of the same one payment of the rents to the Government. Taharun Nessa, wife of Sakender Khan, gifted her property in favour of her four daughters and thereafter passed away leaving son and daughters. Momtaz Begum, daughter of Sakender Khan thereafter expired leaving behind her husband, two daughters and three sisters. Out of 4.07 acres land of late Sekander Khan, defendant No.1, AKM Jahangir Khan, got 1.19 acres land and he also purchased 0.98 acre land from Momtaz Akther through sub-kabala Deed No.4256 dated 11.07.1963 and thus, he acquired 2.17 acres land. Defendant No.1 filed Title Suit No.5733 of 2008 in the Court of Joint District Judge, 6th Court, Dhaka against the co-sharers for partition of their ejmali land and on 25.05.2009, the said suit was decreed on compromise. As per the said decree, 2.17 acres land fell in the saham of defendant No.1 who mutated his name and had been in possession of the said land and had been paying rents regularly to the Government. During B.S. Survey, 2.17 acres land was recorded in the name of defendant No.1 in Plot No.4707 in Khatian No.968 in the field porcha, defendant No.1 constructed a boundary wall on four sides of his 2.17 acres land and constructed three pucca houses therein and he has been in possession of the same by appointing caretaker. Defendant Nos.1-6 previously instituted Title Suit No.325 of 1981 and in the said suit, the plaintiff was impleaded as defendant No.13 and the said suit was decreed in favour of the present defendants. The plaintiffs along with some other miscreants on 03.11.2011 demolished the defendants boundary wall and also constructed semi-pucca houses constructed thereon. The application for injunction is based on a false story and the same is liable to be rejected. 

 11. The present defendant-respondent and his other co-sharers (present defendant Nos. 1-6) as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.325 of 1981 before the then Sub-ordinate Judge, 2" Court, Dhaka impleading the present plaintiff (as defendant No.13) and others for permanent injunction in respect of 5.05 acres land of C.S Khatian No.32 and C.S and S.A Plot No.522 corresponding to R.S. Khatian No.221 and R.S Plot No.1127. The suit was contested by defendant Nos.7 and 13 (present plaintiff) and the learned Sub-ordinate Judge by his judgment and decree dated 01.03.2001 decreed the suit restraining the present plaintiff from dispossessing or disturbing the plaintiffs of that suit from their peaceful possession of the suit property. The present plaintiff did not move the higher Court against the said judgment and decree with a view to challenge the said decree. Thereafter, defendant No.13 of the aforementioned suit, as plain-tiff, instituted present Title Suit No.994of 2012 impleading the present defendants (plaintiff of the previous suit as defendant Nos.1-6) and prayed for declaration of his title in the suit property and for further declaration that 5.05 acres land of R.S Plot No.1127 of R.S. khatian No. 221 published in the name of Alhaj Sekander Khan is wrong and that the name of the predecessor of the present plaintiff wrongly has been omitted and that the title deeds of the plain-tiff in respect of Kha scheduled land are false, forged and collusive and not binding upon the plaintiff only. In the present suit, the plaintiff-petitioner claims title over 2.56 acres land out of 5.05 acres land of C.S and S.A. Plot No.522 corresponding to R.S. Khatian No.221 and R.S. Plot No.1127. The learned Advocate for the defendant-respondent raised objection to the claim of the plaintiff-petitioner and submitted that the present defendant-respondent claims title over 1.17 acres land out of 5.05 acres land and the rest land of the CS Plot No.522 is in possession of the present plaintiff. In reply to the said submission, the learned Advocate for the defendant-respondent has submitted that it would be evident from the written objection of the plaintiff-respondent filed against the application for injunction that defendant No.1 had filed Title Suit No.5733 of 2008 in the 6th Court of the learned Joint District Judge, Dhaka against his co-sharers for partition and obtained a compromise decree on 25.05.2009 and as per solenama, this 2.17 acres land out of 5.05 acres land has fallen in the saham of this defendant-respondent and the rest land has fallen in the saham of other co-sharers.
